philosophy.title: “We don’t discount the execution. We reduce the scope.”
paragraphs: We do not publish a generic per-square-foot sticker price list, nor do we cut material quality to win a bid. When a vendor arbitrarily slashes their price by 30% without changing the scope, they recover that margin by skipping surface decontamination, omitting overlaminate, or using uncalibrated vinyl.

At Decal Authority, execution standards are fixed. If a project requires a lower budget ceiling, we work with your procurement and operations team to adjust the specification or coverage scope—delivering a smaller or simpler system executed to the exact same durability standard.
